_comment: Reference for the Fabric Variable Library 'VL_CICD_Bindings'. Create it in the Fabric portal (Create -> Data Factory -> Variable library), add these variables, then add a value set per stage. The deployment pipeline activates the matching value set per stage (one-time 'Set as active' on each stage), so consumers resolve the correct IDs automatically — no orphaned GUIDs.
_consumers: Notebooks (notebookutils.variableLibrary), Dataflow Gen2 (parameter binding), Data pipeline. NOT consumable by the DirectLake semantic model or PBIR report — those use a deployment data-source rule and Git respectively.

variables.name: WorkspaceId
variables.note: Current-stage workspace ID (all three lakehouses live here)

variables.name: BronzeLakehouseId
variables.note: Bronze_LH item ID in this stage

variables.name: SilverLakehouseId
variables.note: Silver_LH item ID in this stage (also feeds DF_Gold_PA SilverLakehouseId)

variables.name: GoldLakehouseId
variables.note: Gold_LH item ID in this stage

_howConsumersUseIt.Notebook: samplevl = notebookutils.variableLibrary.getLibrary('VL_CICD_Bindings'); build abfss path: f"abfss://{samplevl.WorkspaceId}@onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com/{samplevl.SilverLakehouseId}/Tables/..." — or set the default lakehouse from SilverLakehouseId. No GUID is hardcoded in code, so notebooks never carry an orphaned lakehouse mapping.
_howConsumersUseIt.DataflowGen2: Bind DF_Gold_PA parameters SilverWorkspaceId -> WorkspaceId and SilverLakehouseId -> SilverLakehouseId via the Dataflow's variable-library integration, replacing the deployment-rule parameters.
_howConsumersUseIt.DataPipeline: Optional — PL_Refresh_Master's activity item references are already auto-paired by the deployment pipeline; use the library only if you need stage-specific literals.

_stillNeedsDeploymentRuleOrGit.Gold_SM: DirectLake semantic model is not a variable-library consumer — keep the Data source deployment rule -> ws-CICD-Prod/Gold_LH (see deployment_rules.json).
_stillNeedsDeploymentRuleOrGit.Gold_Dashboard: PBIR report is not supported by deployment pipelines — deliver via Git (connect ws-CICD-Prod to the repo and Update).
